title: Noetherian henselization of a Noetherian pair has the same completion
statement: Let $(A,I)$ be a pair with $A$ Noetherian [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring], and let $(A^h,I^h)$ be its henselization [lem-weil-pbc-pair-henselization], with structure map $\eta:A\to A^h$. Thus $I^h=IA^h$. For the adic completions $A^\wedge=\varprojlim_n A/I^n$ and $(A^h)^\wedge=\varprojlim_n A^h/(I^h)^n$ [def-weil-pbc-adic-completion], the canonical map $A\to A^h$ induces an isomorphism $\theta:A^\wedge\xrightarrow{\sim}(A^h)^\wedge$. Let $\gamma:A^h\to A^\wedge$ be the composite of the completion map $A^h\to(A^h)^\wedge$ with $\theta^{-1}$ (an $A$-algebra map). Moreover $A^h$ is Noetherian, $A\to A^h$ is flat [def-weil-pbc-flat-ring-map], and $\gamma:A^h\to A^\wedge$ is faithfully flat [def-weil-pbc-faithfully-flat-ring-map].

proof.text: Apply [lem-weil-pbc-henselization-flat-quotients] to the given colimit: its structure map is flat and every positive ideal-power quotient map is bijective.
Apply [lem-weil-pbc-henselization-completion-data] to that structure map and the quotient bijectivity, obtaining the canonical completion equivalence and its evaluation and composite identities.

Apply [lem-weil-pbc-henselization-completion-faithfully-flat] with this equivalence and its coordinate compatibility. The base is Noetherian, so the resulting map to the base completion is faithfully flat.

The base completion is Noetherian by [lem-weil-pbc-adic-completion-noetherian]. Give it the algebra structure defined by the faithfully flat map. Apply [lem-weil-pbc-faithfully-flat-descent-noetherian], concretely the Mathlib tensor-product descent theorem with the module equal to the henselization ring, identifying the tensor product with the base completion by Algebra.TensorProduct.rid. Combine the conclusions.

lean.statement: theorem pair_henselization_noetherian_completion (A : Type u) [CommRing A] [IsNoetherianRing A] (I : Ideal A) (c : Cocone (ObjectProperty.ι (fun C : Under (CommRingCat.of A) ↦ AlgebraicGeometry.Etale (AlgebraicGeometry.Spec.map C.hom) ∧ Function.Bijective (Ideal.quotientMap (I.map C.hom.hom) C.hom.hom (Ideal.le_comap_map))))) (hc : IsColimit c) : IsNoetherianRing c.pt.right ∧ c.pt.hom.hom.Flat ∧ ∃ θ : AdicCompletion I A ≃+* AdicCompletion (I.map c.pt.hom.hom) c.pt.right, (∀ (n : ℕ) (x : AdicCompletion I A) (a : A), AdicCompletion.evalₐ I n x = Ideal.Quotient.mk (I ^ n) a → AdicCompletion.evalₐ (I.map c.pt.hom.hom) n (θ x) = Ideal.Quotient.mk ((I.map c.pt.hom.hom) ^ n) (c.pt.hom.hom a)) ∧ (θ.symm.toRingHom.comp (algebraMap c.pt.right (AdicCompletion (I.map c.pt.hom.hom) c.pt.right))).comp c.pt.hom.hom = algebraMap A (AdicCompletion I A) ∧ RingHom.FaithfullyFlat (θ.symm.toRingHom.comp (algebraMap c.pt.right (AdicCompletion (I.map c.pt.hom.hom) c.pt.right)))
